<!-- Generated by /init-unity. Keep this frontmatter; only the body below changes. -->

The Unity project is `TheLastEngineer/` inside the git repo `The-Last-Engineer/`. Paths below are
relative to `TheLastEngineer/`. Gameplay code has no asmdef and no namespace (global namespace,
`Assembly-CSharp`).

## Assets/ folders
| Folder | Holds |
|---|---|
| `Assets/Scripts/` | Almost all gameplay code (systems table below) |
| `Assets/Inspection System/` | Self-contained inspection / corruption-cleaning minigame: `Inspection/`, `Corruption/`, `UI/`, `Prefabs/` |
| `Assets/Prefabs/` | Level modules (`Modulos*`, `Modulo Pisos Cables`, `Level`), `Glitcheables`, `Laser`, `Ascensor` (level-load elevator), `Capsula` (checkpoints), lights, props, particles |
| `Assets/Scenes/` | `BUILD SCENES/` (shipped), `LVL 1/` (new first level, versions 1.0–1.3, not in build), `BLOCKING/`, `TEST LEVELS/<person>/`, `Template_Scene.unity` |
| `Assets/Resources/` | `GlitchPalette.asset`, `LaserData.asset`, `Pause_Menu.prefab`, node/corruption materials and textures |
| `Assets/Art/`, `Assets/Art-2/` | Art per member; shaders, URP render features (`ToonOutlineFeature`, `PlayerXRayFeature`, `PostProcessController`), glitch/dissolve shader scripts (`Art-2/Shaders/ShaderScript`), input prompt sprites |
| `Assets/Editor/` | Editor tools (Prefab Painter, Object Replacer, custom inspectors) and `Build/` (batchmode build) |
| `Assets/Tools/` | `FolderTool/` (hierarchy folders stripped at build), `MapCreator/` (Map Builder) |
| `Assets/Settings/`, `Assets/RenderPipeline/` | URP pipeline assets per quality level, renderers, Build Profiles (`Windows`, `Web`) |
| `Assets/Timelines/` | `ElevatorTimeline.playable` |
| `Assets/Plugins/PrimeTween`, `TextMesh Pro/`, `Samples/`, `MobileDependencyResolver/`, `UI Toolkit/` | Third party — don't edit |
| `Assets/Basura/`, `Assets/Scenes/Posibles referencias (EX OLD)/` | Discarded / old reference — ignore |

## Build scenes (`ProjectSettings/EditorBuildSettings.asset`, all enabled)
| # | Scene | Role |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `Assets/Scenes/BUILD SCENES/0 - MAIN MENU.unity` | Main menu (`MainMenu`, `FadeInController`) |
| 1 | `.../1 - TUTO 1.unity` | Tutorial 1 |
| 2 | `.../2 - TUTO 2.unity` | Tutorial 2 |
| 3 | `.../3 - HUB.unity` | HUB with interactable props, exit to levels |
| 4 | `.../4 - NIVEL PLATAFORMAS.unity` | Moving-platform and teleport level |

Each level scene carries its own Player, `InputManager` and `LevelLoader`, so any level can be played directly.

## Systems → main script (under `Assets/Scripts/` unless noted)
| System | Main script(s) |
|---|---|
| Player (MVC + FSM) | `Player/MVC/PlayerController.cs` (+ `PlayerModel`, `PlayerView`), `Player/StateMachine/PlayerStateMachine.cs` |
| Player components | `Player/Components/`: `InputHandler`, `PlayerNodeHandler`, `GlitchTransferHandler`, `PlayerInteractionDetector`, `InteractableHandler` |
| Input | `Player/InputManager.cs`; actions asset `Core/Insfrastructure/Services/Inputs/PlayerInputs.inputactions` (`PlayerInputs.cs` is generated) |
| Input prompts | `Core/Utilities/InputDeviceDetector.cs`, `InputPromptDatabase.cs`, `UI/InputPromptIcon.cs` |
| Glitch (charge + per-object FSM) | `Gameplay/Glitch/Glitcheable.cs`, `GlitchComponent.cs`, `GlitchTransferManager.cs`, `GlitchPalette.cs`, `State Machine/` |
| Nodes | `Gameplay/Nodes/NodeController.cs` (+ `NodeModel`, `NodeView`), shared enums `Gameplay/Nodes/Enums.cs` |
| Connections | `Gameplay/Connection/Connection.cs` + views |
| Doors | `Gameplay/Doors/DoorsController.cs` (class `DoorController`), `DoorsView.cs` |
| Pressure plates | `Gameplay/Pressure Plate/PressurePlate.cs`, `PressuredDoor.cs` |
| Laser | `Gameplay/Laser/MVC/LaserController.cs` (+ Model/View), `LaserActivator`, receptors; legacy `Gameplay/Laser/Laser.cs` |
| Moving platforms | `Gameplay/Platform/PlatformController.cs`, `PlatformMotor`, `RouteManager`, `StateMachine/`, `PlatformTeleport` |
| Inspection | `Assets/Inspection System/Inspection/Inspectionable.cs`, `InspectionSystem.cs`, `InspectorController.cs`; `Corruption/CorruptionRemover.cs` |
| Cinematics | `Cinematics/CinematicManager.cs`, `CinematicStarter`, `CinematicTrigger` |
| Scene loading | `LevelLoader.cs` (root of `Scripts/`) |
| Checkpoints / respawn | `Player/CheckPointController.cs`, `RespawnPosition.cs` |
| Pause / UI | `UI/PauseGameController.cs` (current); alt `UI/Screen Manager/ScreenManager.cs`; HUD `UI/UpdatePosToTarget.cs`, `UIActionController.cs` |
| Audio | `Utilities/SFXManager.cs`, `UI/UIButtonsManager.cs` |
| Interfaces | `Interfaces/` (`IInteractable`, `IProximityListener`, `ILaserReceptor`, …), `Core/Domain/Puzzles/` (`IConnectable`, `IActivationSource`, `IMovablePassenger`) |
| Death glitch FX | `Assets/Art-2/Shaders/ShaderScript/GlitchDeathController.cs` |
| Prototypes | `Assets/Scenes/TEST LEVELS/Mati/Scripts/` (cauldron, floor dither, spaceship cinematic) |

## Configuration ScriptableObjects
| SO | Asset | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `PlayerData` | `Scripts/Scriptable Objects/PlayerData.asset` | Player tuning: speed, dash, interaction radius, LOS, rumble, transfer timing |
| `GlitchSounds` | `Scripts/Scriptable Objects/` | Glitch cycle SFX |
| `GlitchPalette` | `Resources/GlitchPalette.asset` (`GlitchPalette.Default`) | Single source of glitch-level colors |
| `LaserData` | `Resources/LaserData.asset` (`LaserData.Default`) | Shared laser hit layer mask |
| `InputDeviceDetector`, `InputPromptDatabase` | `Scripts/Core/Utilities/` | Device detection, action × device → prompt sprite |
| `PrefabPainterPalette`, `MapBuilderPalette` | editor tools | Level-painting palettes |

## Key prefabs
- `Assets/Prefabs/Glitcheables/` — `Glitcheable` + `GlitchComponent` + `TimerController` + anchors.
- `Assets/Prefabs/Laser/` — emitters (`LaserController` + `LaserView`), receptors, crystals.
- `Assets/Prefabs/Ascensor/` — level-load elevator; `Assets/Prefabs/Capsula/` — checkpoint capsules.
- `Assets/Inspection System/Prefabs/` — `InspectionSystem` world + UI prefabs.
- `Assets/Resources/Pause_Menu.prefab` — instantiated by `ScreenManager.Push("Pause_Menu")`.
- `Assets/Prefabs/Level/NEW Player.prefab` — the player (`PlayerController` and its components).
